subject: Post-call: phased-close MAP proposal and next steps (Skylab Analytics)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@skylab.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: phased-close MAP proposal and next steps (Skylab Analytics)

Jordan —

Great conversation today, thanks for walking us through Skylab’s ingestion volume and governance constraints. Per our call, I captured a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) that reflects a two-phase approach to reduce risk and compress time-to-value. High-level summary: 

- Objective: deliver an initial pilot that integrates Redwood Inference into Skylab’s feature store for model-serving performance testing, then expand to full rollout across two additional teams.
- Phase 1 (pilot): integrate in one product team, 2‑week POC validation, performance baseline & cost modeling — target close: 2025-07-31
- Phase 2 (expansion): rollout to three teams, production SLA onboarding, multi-region routing — target close: 2025-09-30
- Responsibilities: Skylab provides access to test data and an internal product owner (Alyssa), Redwood delivers deployment, runtime tuning, and an initial quantization profile.
- Dependencies: Skylab procurement signoff, redacted security checklist items (SOC 2 attestation + IP/data usage terms), and a short SOW to confirm deliverables.

Ask: Please review the attached MAP and confirm whether you want to proceed with the phased approach or prefer a single full-close plan. If phased is acceptable, can you confirm internal decision criteria for Phase 1 (performance threshold, security artefacts, POA signing authority)?

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm Phase 1 decision criteria by 2025-05-16
2) Redwood to deliver updated MAP and an SOW draft by 2025-05-14 (attached v1)
3) Procurement looped in for contract cadence

I’ve cc’d Neha (product) and Priyom (solutions engineer) to help scope the Phase 1 success criteria.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments referenced:
- Skylab_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, dates)
- SOW-draft_Skylab_v0.2.pdf (SOW placeholder)
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@skylab.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@skylab.ai>, Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@skylab.ai>
Date: 2025-05-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: phased-close MAP proposal and next steps (Skylab Analytics)

Markus —

Thanks for the quick recap and for capturing those items. The two-phase approach aligns with how our GTM teams want to de-risk this, but procurement just flagged that our vendor onboarding timelines are shifting because of a quarterly finance blackout window. That pushes our earliest contract signature out. Proposed changes from our side: 

- Keep Phase 1 (pilot) target unchanged: 2025-07-31 — this is critical for the Q3 launch our product leads want.
- Reforecast Phase 2 to 2025-10-15 (we'd prefer end of Q3 but procurement says late Q3/early Q4 looks more realistic)
- We need the MAP split into a minimal Phase 1 deliverable (pilot acceptance criteria + acceptance signoff template) vs. Phase 2 scope (SLA + multi-region).

Decision criteria for Phase 1: 1) 50% reduction in 95th percentile inference latency vs current infra baseline OR consistent parity with latency and <15% incremental cost; 2) SOC 2 overview and an engineer contact for live network tests; 3) Signed PO for pilot budget (Alyssa will confirm the exact approver).

I’ve looped Procurement and Alyssa on this thread. Procurement, can you advise the earliest realistic signature date and whether a standalone pilot PO is workable?

—Jordan
VP Product, Skylab Analytics

Subject: Re: Post-call: phased-close MAP proposal and next steps (Skylab Analytics)

Jordan — appreciate the clarity. I’ve attached an updated MAP that separates Phase 1 acceptance artifacts from Phase 2 commitments (file: Skylab_MAP_v1.xlsx — sheet "PhaseSplit"). Key updates: 

- Phase 1 acceptance criteria table (latency, cost delta, feature coverage) with owners: Skylab (Alyssa) validates; Redwood (Priyom) provides validation script and results report.
- Proposed pilot PO amount and timeline for signature by 2025-06-20 to keep dev work on-track for July validation.
- Phase 2 now marked as dependent on procurement completion and a mutually agreed rollout plan; tentative target: 2025-10-15 as you suggested.

Priyom — can you confirm the test harness plan and whether we need any additional sample dataset slices from Skylab to run the performance verification by 7/10?

Procurement loop: if a standalone pilot PO is acceptable to Skylab procurement, we can create a short SOW + limited license invoice that isolates Phase 1 costs. Rishi — want to confirm discount banding for pilot-only POs (we typically reserve full production discounts for Phase 2).

I’ll keep things moving on our side so we can meet the July pilot target.

—
Markus

Team —

Quick internal alignment from my side: agree with the phased close and the pilot-first PO. A couple of notes for the commercial path: 

- Deal ID SKY-2025-0427 created; proposed pilot PO value $28,500 (covers infra/time for pilot + tuning).
- For conversion to Phase 2 (production), we can offer a volume discount tier if Skylab commits within 90 days of pilot acceptance.
- If procurement requires a single contract vehicle, legal can produce an umbrella MSA with a pilot addendum to accelerate signature — that usually helps in blackout windows.

Markus — please attach the SOW-draft_Skylab_v0.2.pdf and I’ll loop in legal to create the umbrella MSA option. Jordan — procurement, if you can share earliest approver and any standard redline points, we’ll try to keep the legal review to 5 business days.

—Rishi
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
